lessons.title: Zorundayım
lessons.goal: have to / has to ile iş ve okuldaki zorunlulukları anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Bir pilotun günü
discover.body:
Captain Selin Arslan is a pilot. She started flying ten years ago.

"My job is amazing, but there are a lot of rules. I have to arrive at the airport two hours before every flight. I have to check the weather and the plane carefully. Pilots also have to take a medical test every year.

I often have to work at night and at weekends, and sometimes I have to sleep in hotels for three or four days. My husband has to look after our daughter when I'm away. It's not easy, but I love flying!"

questions.prompt: When does Selin have to arrive at the airport?
questions.explanation: "I have to arrive at the airport two hours before every flight."

questions.prompt: What do pilots have to do every year?
questions.explanation: "Pilots also have to take a medical test every year."

learn.explanation:
**have to** + yalın fiil → zorunluluk (genellikle kurallardan ya da durumdan gelir)

| | |
|---|---|
| I / You / We / They **have to** | work |
| He / She / It **has to** | work |

- I **have to** get up at six.
- She **has to** wear a uniform.
- We **have to** finish this by Friday.

have to **bir kalıptır**: "have" burada "sahip olmak" anlamında değildir. Okunuşu genellikle /ˈhæftə/, has to ise /ˈhæstə/.

**Zaman ifadeleri:** every day, on Mondays, sometimes, often → I often **have to** work late.

examples.en: I have to take the bus at seven every morning.
examples.tr: Her sabah yedide otobüse binmek zorundayım.

examples.en: My brother has to study for his exam.
Doctors often have to work at night.
examples.tr: Doktorlar sık sık gece çalışmak zorunda kalır.

learn.turkishNote: "-mek zorundayım" ve "-mem lazım / gerek" yapılarının ikisi de have to ile söylenebilir: "Gitmem lazım" = I have to go. Günlük konuşmada "I have to go" bir vedalaşma ifadesi olarak da çok kullanılır (Gitmem lazım, görüşürüz).

learn.explanation:
**don't / doesn't have to** → zorunda değil, gerek yok (istersen yapabilirsin)

- You **don't have to** come. (Gelmek zorunda değilsin.)
- She **doesn't have to** work tomorrow.

**Soru:** Do / Does + özne + have to + fiil?

- **Do** you **have to** wear a uniform? – Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**.
- **Does** he **have to** travel a lot? – Yes, he **does**. / No, he **doesn't**.
- **What time do** you **have to** start?

have to normal bir fiil gibi davranır: soru ve olumsuzda **do / does** kullanılır. ~~Have you to...?~~ / ~~She hasn't to...~~ yanlıştır.

examples.en: It's Saturday. I don't have to get up early.

learn.turkishNote: "Gerek yok" demek için "You don't have to" en doğal yoldur: "Kusura bakma, gelmek zorunda değilsin" = You don't have to come. Bu cümle yasak bildirmez; sadece zorunluluk olmadığını söyler. Yasak için mustn't kullanılır (sonraki ders).

lessons.title: Must ve mustn't
lessons.goal: must ve mustn't ile kuralları ve yasakları anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Yüzme havuzu kuralları
discover.body:
CITY POOL – RULES

1. You must have a shower before you swim.
2. You must wear a swimming cap.
3. You mustn't run near the pool.
4. You mustn't eat or drink in the water.
5. Children under 10 must swim with an adult.
6. You mustn't dive in the shallow end.

Thank you. Have fun and stay safe!

questions.prompt: What must you do before you swim?
questions.explanation: "You must have a shower before you swim."

questions.prompt: Who must swim with an adult?
questions.explanation: "Children under 10 must swim with an adult."

learn.explanation:
**must** + yalın fiil → güçlü zorunluluk, kural (genellikle yazılı kurallarda ya da konuşanın kendi kararında)

- You **must** wear a helmet.
- I **must** call my mum tonight. (Kendi kararım.)

**mustn't** + yalın fiil → **yasak** (yapma!)

- You **mustn't** smoke here.
- You **mustn't** be late.

**must** her özneyle aynıdır, -s ya da to almaz: ~~She musts~~ / ~~You must to~~

**must ve have to:**

| must | have to |
|---|---|
| yazılı kurallar, tabelalar, konuşanın kendi fikri | dışarıdan gelen zorunluluk, günlük konuşma |
| Passengers **must** show their tickets. | I **have to** show my ticket on the bus. |

Günlük konuşmada **have to** çok daha sık kullanılır.

examples.en: Visitors must sign in at the reception.
You mustn't tell anyone. It's a secret!
I must remember to buy bread.

learn.turkishNote: mustn't'ün okunuşunda ilk t okunmaz: /ˈmʌsnt/. Türkçedeki "-meli" eki hem should (tavsiye) hem must (kural) karşılığı olabilir; kural ya da yasak söz konusuysa must/mustn't, tavsiye ise should kullanın.

options: You must to wear a helmet.

learn.explanation:
Bu iki yapı Türkçede birbirine benzese de **anlamları çok farklıdır**:

| | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **mustn't** | YASAK, yapma! | You **mustn't** use your phone. (Kullanamazsın.) |
| **don't have to** | GEREK YOK, istersen yap | You **don't have to** use a pen. (Kalem de olur.) |

**İzin için can / can't:**

- **Can** we use a dictionary? – Yes, you **can**. / No, you **can't**.
- You **can't** park here. (≈ mustn't, günlük dil)

**be allowed to:** You **aren't allowed to** smoke here. (resmi)

**Özet:**

- zorunlu → must / have to
- yasak → mustn't / can't / not allowed to
- gereksiz → don't have to
- izinli → can / be allowed to

You don't have to park here. There's a free car park.

learn.explanation:
**must** ve **have to**'nun geçmiş hali **had to**'dur. (must'ın geçmiş hali yoktur.)

- I **had to** work late yesterday.
- We **had to** wear uniforms at school.

**Olumsuz:** didn't have to → gerek yoktu

- I **didn't have to** pay. It was free.

**Soru:** Did + özne + have to + fiil?

- **Did** you **have to** wait long? – Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**.

**Geçmiş yasak** için genellikle **couldn't** ya da **weren't allowed to** kullanılır:

- We **couldn't** use phones at school. / We **weren't allowed to** talk.

learn.turkishNote: "-mek zorunda kaldım" = I had to. "musted" diye bir kelime yoktur; geçmişte her zaman had to kullanılır. "Didn't have to" da "zorunda kalmadım / gerek olmadı" anlamına gelir.

Hi Murat,
